cases.name: c-preserves-nested-tables-and-arrays
cases.config:
model = "synthetic-model"
fallback_models = ["synthetic-secondary", "synthetic-third"]
window_sizes = [80, 120]
approval_flags = [true, false]
[tui]
notifications = ["agent-turn-complete", "approval-requested"]
[tui.theme]
palette = { accent = "blue", contrast = 1.5 }
[profiles.example]
model = "nested-model"
providers = [{ name = "first", enabled = true }, { name = "second", enabled = false }]
[profiles.example.projects]
labels = ["unrelated", "preserved"]
[[profiles.example.routes]]
name = "first"
args = ["--synthetic", "value"]
[[profiles.example.routes]]
name = "second"
args = []
# Native formatting and this comment need not survive filtering.
[projects."/work/synthetic-array-project"]
trust_level = "trusted"
[mcp_servers.synthetic]
command = "synthetic-server"
